messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and over-the-counter medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are planning to take or are taking. They may interact with tirzepatide, and your doctor may need to change the doses of your medications or monitor you carefully for side effects.
Birth control pills may not work as well while receiving this medicine. Your doctor may suggest you use another form of birth control for 4 weeks after starting tirzepatide and for 4 weeks after each dose change.
Taking tirzepatide with other medicines to treat diabetes, such as sulfonylureas or insulin, may increase your risk of hypoglycemia. Talk to your doctor and pharmacist about low blood sugar and how to manage it.
This medicine delays gastric emptying and may alter the absorption of other orally administered medicines.
This list is not complete. Many other drugs may interact with Mounjaro and Zepbound, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products. To check for interactions with this medicine, click the link below.
Triplet: ["tirzepatide", "requires alternative birth control", "4 weeks after starting"]

The relation 'requires alternative birth control' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug necessitates the use of an alternative form of birth control for the time period specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
B. 'requires washout period': The subject drug necessitates a specific period of time specified by the object entity before switching to another medication to avoid adverse interactions.
C. 'requires adjustment of': The subject drug necessitates changes or modifications to the treatment or dosage specified by the object entity.
D. 'may be used for': The subject drug can be used for the purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
E. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
F. None of the above.
